subject.title: feat: add Messages Name & Photo sharing

question: After exact-head live proof, should `imsg` adopt `name-photo` and `contacts.shouldShareContact`/`contacts.shareContactCard` as supported public contracts?
rationale: The change commits the project to undocumented, privacy-sensitive private-API behavior and external compatibility vocabulary; tests and source inspection cannot determine that product intent.

options.title: Adopt proven guarded APIs
options.body: Approve the public surface after live evidence confirms liveness, iMessage-only targeting, participant scope, sender identity, and receiver-visible behavior.

options.title: Keep capability internal
options.body: Retain only validated bridge internals and defer the public CLI and compatibility RPC commitments.

options.title: Decline private sharing
options.body: Do not support the mutation if maintainers do not want to own its runtime, privacy, and compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt proven guarded APIs
recommendation.body: Approve the public surface after live evidence confirms liveness, iMessage-only targeting, participant scope, sender identity, and receiver-visible behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The collaborator author owns the active replacement and current bridge baseline, with Omar Shahine providing complementary bridge and runtime context.
